definitions.gloss: truth; true facts; the real situation
definitions.explanation: The actual facts behind an event or situation, especially one that has been unclear, hidden, or disputed. Often used in the context of investigations, mysteries, or scandals.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{真相|しんそう}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To investigate the truth behind the incident.

examples.japanese: {真相|しんそう}は{誰|だれ}にも{分|わ}からないままだ。
examples.english: The truth remains unknown to everyone.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{調査|ちょうさ}の{末|すえ}に、ようやく{事故|じこ}の{真相|しんそう}が{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: After years of investigation, the truth behind the accident was finally revealed.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when referring to hidden or disputed facts, not for everyday truths. Frequently appears in news, detective stories, and discussions of scandals or unsolved cases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真相|しんそう}を{明|あき}らかにする (to reveal the truth)
- {真相|しんそう}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める (to get to the bottom of the truth)
- {真相|しんそう}{究明|きゅうめい} (investigation of the truth)
- {事件|じけん}の{真相|しんそう} (the truth behind the incident)
- {真相|しんそう}は{闇|やみ}の{中|なか} (the truth remains in the dark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {事実|じじつ}: fact — a neutral, objective term; does not imply anything was hidden
- {真実|しんじつ}: truth — more philosophical and emotional; the deeper truth of a matter
